svg.title: Auction platform — Kubernetes deployment details
svg.text: Production overlay • auction-platform namespace • 13 application Deployments • 27 configured replicas • 12 autoscalers
Workloads, scaling and declared Service mappings
Initial = Deployment replicas; HPA = allowed replica range. Scale follows utilization of resource requests.
Each service uses its own dependencies.
Application scale envelope: 27 initial replicas; up to 93 at configured HPA maxima + fixed web replicas.
Backend pod resources: requests 200m CPU / 512Mi; limits 1000m CPU / 1Gi.
13 application PodDisruptionBudgets declare minAvailable: 1; rollout waits for migration Jobs.
The scale envelope excludes AKS system pods, operators, migration Jobs and the two infrastructure pods.
Port mappings above are declared Services. Active internal gRPC relationships: Auction ↔ Bidding; Auction → Catalog.
Source: rendered production Kustomize overlay, service configuration and Azure Bicep • 24 October 2026
